_comment: Scheduled live course groups. Set `courseKey` and `courseName`, then include course-sessions.njk. With sessions the page renders bookable dates, each with its own Stripe payment link; with an empty list it falls back to the application form, so the page is always valid. Add a month: { date (ISO), label (Latvian, as shown), time, format, seats, url (Stripe payment link) }. Policy numbers are read by the templates - change them here, not in the copy. `lateBookingGraceHours` keeps the refund promise at least as generous as the statutory 14-day withdrawal right for someone who books inside the refund window. `vatRate` is the rate the Stripe payment links must add on top of the displayed price.
